signInEmail.body:
Hello,

Click this link to sign in to Jobbbox:
{{url}}

This link is valid for {{minutes}} minutes and works only once.

The Jobbbox team

signIn.title: Sign in to Jobbbox
signIn.intro: No password to remember: get a sign-in link by email, or use your Google account. If you don't have an account yet, one will be created.
signIn.sent: Sent! Open the email we just sent you and click the link to sign in.
signIn.error: Something went wrong. Check your email address and try again.
signIn.linkError: This sign-in link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one below.
signIn.failed: Sign-in didn't go through. Try again below, with Google or with a link by email.

accountData.title: My data
accountData.exportHint: Download everything you saved in Jobbbox: your profiles, every version of your CVs, your applications and their documents.
accountData.deleteWarning: Your account is closed at once and you are signed out. Your profiles, CVs, applications, documents, the access you gave coaches and your coaching session notes are erased, permanently within 30 days at most. Your subscription, if you have one, ends. Download your data first if you want to keep it.
accountData.confirmLabel: To confirm, type your email address
accountData.confirmMismatch: This address does not match your account's. Nothing was deleted.
accountData.deleteError: The deletion could not be completed. Nothing was deleted: try again in a moment.

accountDeleted.title: Your account is deleted
accountDeleted.body: Your data has been erased. Thank you for using Jobbbox, and good luck with your job search.

profiles.title: My profiles

cvUpload.intro: Upload your CV. We read it and split it into sections; you check and correct the result before saving it.

errors.too_large: This file is larger than 10 MB. Save your CV as a smaller file and try again.
errors.unreadable: We couldn't open this file. It may be damaged or password-protected.
errors.empty: We found no text in this file. If it is a scanned CV, upload the original PDF or Word version instead.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

cvUpload.fromScratchHint: No CV at hand? Fill in your master CV and search criteria yourself.

cvEditor.title: Edit my Master CV
cvEditor.intro: Add, edit, move or remove the entries of each section. Each save creates a new version: earlier ones stay available and can be restored.

cvEditor.error: Your CV could not be saved. Please try again.

versions.title: Master CV version history
versions.intro: Each time you save your Master CV, a version is created. View an earlier version or restore it: it becomes the current version, and the history is kept.
versions.restoreError: This version could not be restored. Please try again.

profileActions.name: Profile name

profileActions.archivedNotice: This profile is archived. Restore it to see it in the profile switcher again.
profileActions.error: The change could not be saved. Please try again.

newProfile.title: Create a profile
newProfile.intro: Your coach helps you build your reference CV and search criteria. Choose how to start: you can check and correct everything before saving.
newProfile.withoutCv: I don't have an up-to-date CV
newProfile.withoutCvIntro: Your coach asks you about your career, one question at a time. You can skip the ones that don't apply to you. It takes about ten minutes.

questionnaire.title: Your coach's questions
questionnaire.welcome: Hello, I'm your Jobbbox coach. I'm going to ask you a few questions to build your reference CV. Answer in your own words: you can read it all again and correct it at the end.

questions.fullName: To start with, what is your full name?
questions.targetRole: Which position are you looking for? For example: "Chief Financial Officer".
questions.location: Which city do you live in, or would you like to work in?
questions.email: Which email address can recruiters write to?
questions.phone: Which phone number can they call you on?
questions.jobTitle: Let's talk about your experience. What was the title of job no. {{number}}, starting with the most recent?
questions.employer: Which employer did you hold this job with?
questions.jobDescription: What were your main duties and achievements in this job?
questions.moreExperience: Have you held another job that should be on your CV?
questions.degree: Let's talk about your education. What is your degree or training no. {{number}}?
questions.year: In which year did you obtain it?
questions.moreEducation: Do you have another degree or training to add?
questions.skills: What are your main skills? Separate them with commas.
questions.languages: Which languages do you speak, and how well? For example: "English: fluent, German: basic".
questions.summary: Finally, how would you introduce yourself to a recruiter in a few sentences?

errors.required: This answer is needed to create your profile.

questionnaire.reviewIntro: Here are your reference CV and search criteria, built from your answers. Correct or complete each field if needed, then save your profile.

companyDossier.title: Company dossier
companyDossier.intro: Gather public information about the employer: identity, address, key figures and roles to contact.
companyDossier.unavailable: The sources are unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
companyDossier.notACompany: This name or SIREN is not a company: a sole trader is a private person, and nothing is looked up about them. Enter the name of the hiring company.
companyDossier.employerUnknown: The offer does not name the employer. Name it to build the dossier.
companyDossier.postedByAgency: This offer is posted by a recruiting agency ({{agency}}).
companyDossier.postedByAgencyUnnamed: This offer is posted by a recruiting agency.
companyDossier.noPresumedEmployer: The real employer could not be guessed.
companyDossier.confirmBeforeLookup: Confirm the employer or name the right one: nothing is looked up before you confirm.
companyDossier.employerHint: The company's name, or its SIREN number if you know it.
companyDossier.nameEmployer: Build the dossier for this employer
companyDossier.notInRegister: A French company the register did not find under this name? Enter its SIREN below (“Not the right employer?”) to get its official data.

companyDossier.noFinancials: The company does not publish financial figures.

enrichedContacts.title: Enriched Contacts
enrichedContacts.intro: Find the people holding the roles to contact at the employer, then get their contact details from a licensed data provider. Each contact whose details you get counts toward your monthly quota.
enrichedContacts.needsDossier: Build the company dossier first: it tells which roles to look for.
enrichedContacts.searchUnsupported: The current data provider cannot search for people by role.
enrichedContacts.revealHint: Each request for contact details counts as one Enriched Contact in this month's quota. Nothing is counted if the provider has none.
enrichedContacts.personalData: This personal data comes from a licensed provider. Use it only for this application.
enrichedContacts.useInOutreach: You can address your outreach message to one of these contacts.
enrichedContacts.noDetails: The provider has no contact details for this person. Nothing was counted.
enrichedContacts.unavailable: The data provider is not answering right now. Nothing was counted. Try again in a few minutes.
enrichedContacts.error: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

atsScore.title: ATS Score
atsScore.intro: How applicant tracking systems (ATS) read your Master CV for the role “{{role}}”.

checks.headline: A headline at the top of the CV
checks.skillsList: At least 3 skills, one per line

atsScore.missingHint: Add them yourself, only if they match your real experience.
atsScore.computedOn: Computed on version {{version}} of your Master CV.
atsScore.outdated: Your Master CV has changed since: recompute to see your up-to-date score.
atsScore.notYet: Measure your Master CV: the coach will propose fixes, to accept or reject one by one.
atsScore.error: The score could not be computed. Try again.

atsFixes.seniorAdviceOptional: This advice is optional: you may ignore it.

headline_missing.title: Add a headline to your CV
headline_missing.body: ATS read the CV's headline first. It will become “{{headline}}”, the role you are aiming for.

skills_on_one_line.title: Split your skills
skills_on_one_line.body: “{{skill}}” will become {{count}} skills: {{into}}. ATS read one skill per line better.

decorations.title: Remove decorative symbols
decorations.body: ATS misread emoji and symbols (★, ✓, ►…). They will be removed; the rest of the text stays the same.

headline_without_role.title: Put your target role in the headline
headline_without_role.body: Your headline “{{current}}” does not name the role you are aiming for. It will become “{{headline}}”.

keyword_not_listed.title: Add “{{skill}}” to your skills
keyword_not_listed.body: Your CV already mentions “{{skill}}”, but not in your skills, where ATS look for it first.

age.title: Senior Advice: remove your age
age.body: “{{from}}” will be removed. Age has no place on a CV and can count against your application.

birth_date.title: Senior Advice: remove your birth date
birth_date.body: “{{from}}” will be removed. A birth date has no place on a CV and can count against your application.

experience_years.title: Senior Advice: write “{{to}}”
experience_years.body: “{{from}}” will become “{{to}}”. Beyond 15 years, the number of years puts age forward rather than expertise.

old_experience.title: Senior Advice: remove an old job
old_experience.body: “{{title}}” at {{employer}} ({{period}}) will be removed from the CV. Recruiters mostly look at the last 15 to 20 years.

photo.title: Senior Advice: leave out your photo
photo.body: Your CV shows a photo. Leave it out of the file you send: ATS cannot read it, and it puts age forward rather than expertise.

cvExport.title: Download my Master CV
cvExport.intro: Choose a CV template: all of them are built to be read well by applicant tracking systems (one column, no images or tables).

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: Serif font, centred header, underlined headings.

modern.name: Modern
modern.description: Sans-serif font, left-aligned header, dark blue headings.

compact.name: Compact
compact.description: Denser, to fit on fewer pages.

tailoredDocuments.title: Cover letter and outreach message
tailoredDocuments.draftsOnly: Jobbbox never sends anything for you: copy the text or open it in your mail app, then send it yourself.
tailoredDocuments.languageHint: By default, the job offer's language. A change applies to the next draft.

coverLetter.title: Cover letter
coverLetter.none: The coach drafts a letter from your reference CV and the job offer. You can edit it.

outreachMessage.title: Outreach message
outreachMessage.none: A short message to a contact at the employer, by email or LinkedIn InMail. You can edit it.
outreachMessage.recipientNone: No one in particular (the roles to contact)
outreachMessage.notAContact: This contact is no longer available. Choose another one.

tailoredDocuments.copyFailed: Copying failed: select the text and copy it yourself.
tailoredDocuments.redraftHint: A new draft replaces the current text, your changes included.
tailoredDocuments.unavailable: The coach could not draft this text right now. Try again in a few minutes.
tailoredDocuments.error: Saving failed. Check your connection and try again.

tailoredCv.factsOnly: The coach adapts your reference CV to this offer: it rephrases, reorders, cuts and emphasises what it says, and never invents anything. What the offer asks for and your CV does not show, you are asked about.
tailoredCv.languageHint: The offer's language by default. It is also the cover letter's and outreach message's; a change applies to the next proposal.
tailoredCv.none: No tailored CV yet. The coach proposes one, which you check before saving it.
tailoredCv.noneSinceSaved: You can ask for a new proposal: the saved CV stays in place until you save another one.
tailoredCv.proposed: Proposal ready: check the changes before saving.
tailoredCv.scoreLabel: Match Score: {{master}} out of 100 with the reference CV, {{tailored}} out of 100 with the tailored CV
tailoredCv.questionsIntro: The offer asks for these, which your reference CV does not show. They are added only if you confirm you have them.
tailoredCv.question: Do you have this skill or experience: {{requirement}}?
tailoredCv.noChanges: No changes: the tailored CV is your reference CV as it is.
tailoredCv.saveHint: Saving replaces the tailored CV already saved for this application, if any.
tailoredCv.saved: Tailored CV saved on the application.
tailoredCv.unavailable: The coach could not propose a tailored CV right now. Try again in a few minutes.
tailoredCv.masterCvChanged: Your reference CV changed since this proposal: ask for a new proposal before saving.
tailoredCv.proposalChanged: This proposal changed since you reviewed it (in another tab?): review it again before saving.
tailoredCv.error: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
